newsitem.title: UK: UK shares break three-day slide as bonds gain.
newsitem.headline: UK shares break three-day slide as bonds gain.

text.p: UK shares bounced on Wednesday from three days of losses, tracking higher bonds in the wake of the U.S. decision to leave interest rates unchanged.
A shaky start on Wall Street pulled the FTSE 100 index below the day's best and by the close the FTSE 100 was up 25.2 points at 3,935.7, below the day's peak.
Rising stocks were in a near five-to-one majority with banks, oil and retail stocks among the biggest gainers.
"Having had quite a big fall we were looking oversold," said one trader. "There has been obvious relief that the Fed did nothing and we have seen a few buyers again."
